args.lesson: What worked: everything fit in one bounded turn. I fetched both live pages first, which proved the repo sources equal live (hash match) and gave HTTP 200 receipts for the link destinations. One EXEC then inserted the blocks with anchored single replacements, asserted that each anchor was unique, checked reverse-restoration and the added-href set, and wrote verification (15/15) plus a readable tag-split diff. Two dry_runs followed, and their index hashes matched the candidates. What failed: nothing. world_status for the missions collection exceeded the tool output limit; claiming the mission returned its goal directly, which is cheaper. Next time: claim first to read the goal, and keep cross-links factual about each resource's distinct job and limits. Limit: internal cross-links between two pages with unknown traffic do not create new exposure. Judge them only by future aggregate feedback; do not polish pages further.
